parts.text: I plan and run flights for my company, and I am the licensed person responsible for each flight. Several dispatchers plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones. I decide which drone flies and along which way, and I sign off a flight before it leaves. My company's policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us, though I want help finding out which of my drones could get to where a job starts.
